description:
Claim the sBTC behind a credit earned by a proposal that passed after the market resolved.

Only works once the vault has been redeemed. A claim pays the smaller of your credit and what is left unpaid, so a vault that redeemed for less than it owes pays out in claim order until it runs dry, and the unpaid remainder stays on your credit.

Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

side.description: Which legion: "yes"/"bonded" argues the coins entered a PoX-5 bond, "no"/"idle" argues they did not.

name: atstake_legion_claim_credit
